hooks.name: Verify on task completion
hooks.description: After a spec task is marked complete, run the web verify suite + build and the worker checks. No-ops for whichever package is not yet set up.

action.command: if [ -d web ] && [ -d web/node_modules ]; then (cd web && npm run -s verify && npm run -s build) || echo "pigeonhole: web verify/build FAILED"; else echo "pigeonhole: web deps not installed — skipping web verify"; fi; if [ -f worker/pyproject.toml ]; then (cd worker && ruff check . && mypy . && pytest -q) || echo "pigeonhole: worker checks FAILED"; fi
